messages:
Asha: Quick follow-up from the RFC — thinking about adding tenant-scoped pin metadata that can override global pins for Dedicated/Private customers. Wanted ops/runtime concerns before we add it to the schema.

Asha: Proposed minimal shape:
```json
{ "pin": "model:sha256:abcd...", "scope": "tenant", "tenant_id": "org-123", "expires_at": null }
```

Marco: If we allow tenant override, we need to ensure routing respects precedence and we don't leak pins across tenants. Eviction/lease semantics need to be per-tenant. :warning:

Priya: Runtime note: per-tenant pins -> more lookup keys on the hot path. Cache key becomes (tenant_id, model_id). Batching across tenants becomes trickier. We could fall back to global pin for batch coalescing but that changes semantics and could surprise customers.

Sam: Product: customers will also expect to pin to a variant (e.g., quantized) vs a canonical model. API should expose `effective_pin` and `pin_hierarchy` so teams can see what actually served.

Asha: Tradeoff idea: add an `affinity` hint with values `exclusive` vs `shared`. Default `exclusive` for enterprise tenants (strong isolation). If `shared`, runtime may coalesce across tenants to save cost. That gives opt-in for cost-sensitive tenants.

Marco: How do we enforce `affinity` at runtime? Runtime needs to check the flag before merging into batches. Also we should emit telemetry events when we coalesce across tenants due to `shared` affinity so we can measure cost impact vs isolation.

Priya: Schema suggestion (normalized):
```json
{ "pin": "m:abc123", "scope": "tenant", "tenant": "org-1", "affinity": "exclusive", "expires": null }
```
Implementation note: cache key uses affinity: `exclusive` -> strict tenant-scoped cache key, `shared` -> allow global batching bucket.

Sam: :thumbsup: UI should surface the computed fallback chain (global -> tenant -> variant) so customers understand why a particular model was served.

Asha: Ops/migration concern: new schema should default to no tenant pins. Existing global pins remain untouched. Only new tenant pins adopt `affinity`. Also add validation so tenant pins can't reference model versions the tenant is not authorized to use.

Marco: Control plane must enforce access checks (model access list, KMS mapping). Also recommend a TTL on tenant pins to avoid accidental long-lived overrides.

Priya: I'll add perf tests to quantify batching regression and a runbook for degraded batching scenarios (how to flip affinity and how to debug pin leakage).

Asha: OK — I'll update the schema PR with `scope` and `affinity`, include the examples, add notes about access checks, TTL defaults, and telemetry events. Plan to merge by EOD unless there are objections.
